mAadhaar App Discontinued, Replaced by New Aadhaar App

The mAadhaar mobile application has been discontinued by the UIDAI, with June 30, 2026, marking its final day of operation. Users are advised to uninstall the old app and install the new Aadhaar app, which offers updated features for managing Aadhaar-related services. The new app aims to provide enhanced security and user control over personal data.
